post_card_binding.title: September CPI: why 0.6% and 3.7% answer different questions
post_card_binding.subtitle: In its October 14 release on September 2026 CPI, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported monthly and annual readings with different horizons and adjustment bases.

body_lines: In September 2026, all-items CPI rose 0.6% and CPI excluding food and energy rose 0.3%, both seasonally adjusted
Over the twelve months ending September, all-items CPI-U increased 3.7%; CPI-U excluding food and energy increased 2.6%. Those annual figures are not seasonally adjusted.
